explanation.headline: Vancomycin hydrochloride is not on FDA's shortage list as of 2026-10-21; Corvale East has 18.2 days on hand for 1.25 g vials and 29.7 days for 1 g/200 mL bags; Corvale General has 21.3 days and 27.6 days respectively

sentences.text: FDA's drug shortage list shows vancomycin hydrochloride is not listed as of 2026-10-21.
Corvale East holds 277 vials of the 1.25 g presentation at 15.2 vials per day, providing 18.2 days on hand.
Corvale East also holds 412 bags of the 1 g/200 mL presentation at 13.9 bags per day, providing 29.7 days on hand.
Corvale General holds 338 vials of the 1.25 g presentation at 15.9 vials per day, providing 21.3 days on hand.
Corvale General also holds 447 bags of the 1 g/200 mL presentation at 16.2 bags per day, providing 27.6 days on hand.
The top-ranked purchasing option by rule is to buy from Avenacy, LLC, which is not on FDA's shortage list today and its label names no plant we could place.
A prior FDA shortage posting for Hospira, Inc., a Pfizer Company, was marked To Be Discontinued with an initial posting date of 2025-11-14.

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.
